To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a univariate sampling of BRDFs is sufficient to estimate the parameters of commonly used analytic BRDF models; (2) the parameters of the analytic BRDF model are sufficient to reconstruct surface normals from a collocated camera-light source setup; and (3) we can reconstruct spatially-varyng BRDFs from univariate BRDF samples using a reflectance prior and a dictionary-based approach.
